title: Expectation of a correlated sign pair
statement: Let $\theta\in[-1,1]$, and let $H$ be a real-valued function on pairs of signs. Under the distribution that chooses a uniform sign $X$ and then sets $Y=X$ with probability $(1+\theta)/2$ and $Y=-X$ otherwise, the expectation of $H(X,Y)$ is $\bigl((1+\theta)(H(1,1)+H(-1,-1))+(1-\theta)(H(1,-1)+H(-1,1))\bigr)/4$.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is a real-valued function on pairs of signs
